findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler leaves the StatefulDetectorHandler abstract methods unimplemented, so it cannot be instantiated.
findings.body:
`StatefulDetectorHandler` is an `abc.ABC` with abstract `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and the new `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses it with only `pass`.

**Trigger:** `Detector.detector_handler` instantiates the handler registered on the grouptype, and `MetricAlertFire` presumably registers this class. Any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` that reaches `process_detectors` will then raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`.

**What changes:** before this PR the handler's `evaluate` returned `[]`, so these detectors produced no results without failing. Now they crash.

**What I couldn't check:** whether `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` points at this class. That line is outside this hunk.

**Fix:** either keep a stub that inherits from `DetectorHandler` until the stateful version is implemented, or add stub implementations of the three abstract methods here.
